description: AGU's journal class agujournal2025.cls ([11/12/2024] in its \ProvidesClass), the one class for all AGU journals. Not on CTAN or the engine's mirror (MiKTeX's aguplus is the old AGU++ bundle): from github.com/AGU-Publications/agujournal2025-latex-template at commit 3550522 (2026-03-27), the repository that agu.org/publications/authors/journals links as AGU's GitHub template. agu.org's own zip of the older agujournal2019.cls (an .ashx under agu.org/publications/authors/-/media) refuses scripted downloads (HTTP 403), so the 2019 class is not used; the repository has no licence file (kept private). draft is the option the template sets (agujournaltemplate.tex l.1-4): without published the class takes its 'old code' branch (agujournal2025.cls l.812 on), the agujournal2019 manuscript layout: one column, letter paper, a self-contained article-like class (no \LoadClass), apacite citations with \let\cite\shortcite (l.1970-1972), lineno, and a 'manuscript submitted to <journal>' running head. published (the Wiley typeset look, which needs unicode-math, STIX Two Math, TeX Gyre Adventor, draftwatermark and the repository's tweaklist-git-moderncv-fixed.sty) is not used. \journalname fills the running head, which otherwise reads 'Please set Journal Name by using \journalname' (l.1371-1372); the template calls it after \begin{document}, but it is a plain \def, so the preamble works. In the draft layout \title typesets its title at once (agujournal2025.cls l.1376) and \maketitle does nothing (l.822), so a \title in the preamble stopped at 'Missing \begin{document}'. The last line keeps a preamble \title until \maketitle and runs the class's own \title there, and leaves \title as the class has it after \begin{document} (the \document=\@notprerr test iopart's line uses); \maketitle then also runs the class's own. Probe run 41977413848: the control case stops at 'Missing \begin{document}', the held cases (title in the preamble, title in the body) do not.
